name: fix149_corpse_gear
verifies: fix-149 [owner] ("items I took from the corpse do not disappear"): a skeleton killed with its weapons sheathed shows its rusty sword and wooden shield on the body (carried=2); looting takes both and the body shows nothing (carried=0), also after save/load. A skeleton killed with the sword drawn drops the sword and the shield of its left hand (G3 DropHandItems: both hands) as world items (droppedby=2), its body shows neither and its loot does not give them a second time; they are picked up from the ground
steps: log -- sheathed: the weapons stay on the corpse until looted
log -- drawn: G3 DropHandItems drops the sword and the shield
spawn Gotha_Skeleton_01 attitude=hostile dist=4 side=left as=k
notes: Gotha_Skeleton_01 carries It_1H_Sword_Rust_01 + It_Shield_Wood_03 as weaponry (npcInventories). `loot` is the CP quick loot (Take all). The sheathed half uses a content skeleton (bring): dev spawns (~devNN) are not saved, so one would be gone after the load (fix-164). lootgear:X counts the weaponry stacks of X's loot (the lying ones are left out: no duplicate), carried:X counts CarriedWeaponsView props, droppedby:X the world items owned by X (ScenarioRunner.Fix149.cs).
